summary: Senior product designer with a track record in design systems and measurable UX improvement. Built and maintained the design system used by 40 product teams at Zalando, and redesigned the mobile upload flow at SoundCloud to lift completion 24%. Brings strong craft and consistency to product work, with a focus on typography, accessibility and Figma-based systems.
